patches.title: Open Surface Priority
patches.principle: Always search all open surfaces (countertops, dining tables) before opening any closed container.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible and containers exist.

patches.title: Avoid Empty-Handed Transformation
patches.principle: Do not go to the sink, microwave, or fridge unless you are holding the object that needs transformation.
patches.when_to_apply: When the next intended action is to clean, heat, or cool an object.

patches.title: Direct Sequence After Pickup
patches.principle: After picking up the target object, complete the transformation and placement in immediate succession without detours.
patches.when_to_apply: Immediately after acquiring the target object for a manipulation task.
